fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on the need for a “fair press” and commentary on political rhetoric; gambling and the Dade Crime Commission; a dispute involving the Miami Herald and a printers’/typographical union fight tied to publisher John S. Knight; an open letter to Gov. Fuller Warren urging action regarding Florida Power & Light and public ownership of utilities; municipal court and crimes-court observations; concerns about lax contractor licensing in Dade County; horse racing logistics after Tropical Park and ahead of Hialeah/Gulfstream; estimates and discussion of Florida water resources for population growth; tax burden estimates for Floridians; features on entertainment and nightclub openings; and civic complaints including delayed ambulance response, bus-accident handling, and a call for poison-sale controls after pet poisonings.
